title: A Trip to Samarkand
sentences: Last summer, I went on a trip to Samarkand with my cousin.
O'tgan yozda amakivachcham bilan Samarqandga sayohat qildim.
We took the fast train from Tashkent, and it was very comfortable.
Toshkentdan tezyurar poyezdga o'tirdik, u juda qulay edi.
The journey took only two hours.
Yo'l bor-yo'g'i ikki soat davom etdi.
First, we visited the Registan.
Avval Registonni ziyorat qildik.
The ancient buildings were more beautiful than in the pictures.
Qadimiy binolar suratlardagidan ham chiroyliroq edi.
We took a lot of photos and bought some souvenirs.
Ko'p suratga tushdik va bir nechta esdalik sovg'alar sotib oldik.
For lunch, we tried the famous Samarkand bread.
Tushlikda mashhur Samarqand nonini tatib ko'rdik.
In the evening, we were tired but very happy.
Kechqurun charchagan, lekin juda xursand edik.
I want to go there again next year.
Kelasi yili u yerga yana bormoqchiman.

title: My New Job
sentences: Two weeks ago, I started a new job at a bank.
Ikki hafta oldin bankda yangi ishni boshladim.
On my first day, I was a little nervous.
Birinchi kunim biroz hayajonlandim.
My manager showed me the office and introduced me to everyone.
Rahbarim menga ofisni ko'rsatdi va hammaga tanishtirdi.
My colleagues are friendly and very helpful.
Hamkasblarim samimiy va juda yordamchi.
I have to learn many new things every day.
Har kuni ko'p yangi narsalarni o'rganishim kerak.
Sometimes it is difficult, but it is always interesting.
Ba'zan qiyin, lekin doim qiziqarli.
I usually finish work at six and walk home.
Odatda ishni oltida tugatib, uyga piyoda qaytaman.
I think I made the right decision.
O'ylaymanki, to'g'ri qaror qildim.

title: Cooking Plov
sentences: Plov is the most popular dish in Uzbekistan.
Palov O'zbekistondagi eng mashhur taom.
My grandfather cooks the best plov in our family.
Oilamizda eng mazali palovni bobom pishiradi.
Last Friday, he showed me his recipe.
O'tgan juma u menga o'z retseptini ko'rsatdi.
First, he heated oil in a big pot.
Avval katta qozonda yog' qizdirdi.
Then he added meat, onions and a lot of yellow carrots.
Keyin go'sht, piyoz va ko'p sariq sabzi qo'shdi.
After that, he washed the rice and put it on top.
Shundan so'ng guruchni yuvib, ustiga soldi.
We waited for about forty minutes.
Taxminan qirq daqiqa kutdik.
When the guests arrived, the plov was ready.
Mehmonlar kelganda palov tayyor edi.
Everyone said it was delicious.
Hamma uni juda mazali dedi.

title: A Rainy Day
sentences: Yesterday, I wanted to go for a walk in the park.
Kecha parkda sayr qilmoqchi edim.
But when I opened the door, it started to rain.
Lekin eshikni ochganimda yomg'ir yog'a boshladi.
I forgot my umbrella at work.
Soyabonimni ishda unutib qoldiribman.
After five minutes, my clothes were completely wet.
Besh daqiqadan keyin kiyimlarim butunlay ho'l bo'ldi.
So I changed my plan and went back home.
Shuning uchun rejamni o'zgartirib, uyga qaytdim.
I made a cup of hot tea and sat by the window.
Bir piyola issiq choy damlab, deraza yoniga o'tirdim.
I listened to the rain and read my favorite book.
Yomg'irni tinglab, sevimli kitobimni o'qidim.
It was a quiet and cozy evening.
Bu sokin va shinam oqshom bo'ldi.
